reviews.text: They are the best veterinarians in the world! They have a lot of empathy, great professionalism, and an unconditional love for animals.
Warm welcome, kind and honest.
I greatly appreciate this veterinarian and his entire team. Thank you!

A huge THANK YOU and BRAVO to this clinic and its excellent and competent vets and team in all their fields. Our animals, including those of my parents and friends, have been treated there since the 1980s. We can go there with complete confidence to seek explanations, advice, and care, even when serious decisions need to be made.
Excellent veterinary clinic

My dog ​​was very unwell, so I took him to an emergency veterinary clinic where they did absolutely nothing except leave him in a cage. After I got him back, I took him to this clinic where the vet took him in immediately. She performed all the necessary examinations. I thank her for her responsiveness and especially her professionalism. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

A little gem! I was sent to this clinic by chance, and the reception was exceptional in every way. And what can I say about the vet? She was simply fabulous and explained everything perfectly, telling me exactly what was wrong with my dog!

I'm seriously considering switching vets so they can become my regular vet... I highly recommend them!

Having arrived by chance, I thank the veterinarians for the time they dedicated, first during the consultation, then on the phone for the follow-up. No unnecessary tests or upsells here to inflate the bill, just time, explanations, and advice. Thanks also to the assistants. Highly recommended.
Very welcoming. My pet is very well cared for there.
Very pleasant nursing staff

Very humane and competent veterinarians.
They saved my cat without much discussion about fees. They were very accommodating on price and very caring towards animals.

Nothing but praise for this very attentive clinic.
Reassuring and effective, my dog ​​won't hesitate to go back!
Excellent veterinarians, attentive and competent. My two cats receive efficient and compassionate care there.

My cat Socrates received emergency care as he was very ill due to a tumor. The reception, diagnosis, treatment, explanations, and price were all very clear and honest.
Dr. Sègue is very professional, conscientious, and offers excellent advice. Thank you.

A small, friendly clinic.
Veterinarians who are caring towards animals. A loyal customer since 1973!
Fantastic vet! Very gentle, patient, and attentive. I was very worried, and my pet was seen quickly. Even my cat felt at ease.
Very professional and caring
Such nice staff who were happy to have me come in an emergency to help with my cat. I’m so glad they’re in the neighborhood.

This veterinary clinic has been caring for my pets 😻 for over 20 years. I have complete confidence in them; everyone is very competent and incredibly attentive. You can feel their love for animals.

Thank you. MC.

I have complete confidence in them. From the initial welcome to the care provided, I find them very dedicated. Furthermore, they take care of the follow-up after treatment, demonstrating a genuine interest in the animal.

The young man at reception is kind and attentive, and the veterinarians are very dedicated, readily available, and highly competent. They have treated several of my animals, are honest, and very respectful of the animal, regardless of the issue, even serious ones. My dog ​​shows real signs of affection towards the team...despite painful treatments. She's happy to go there...she must understand that this is a caring environment. She gets treats once the treatment is complete and understands that they mean well. Cats are a little more hesitant, by nature. I remain loyal to these two veterinarians because I believe they have an exceptional commitment and a passion for animal welfare while remaining honest in their practice.

Very professional! Loves his job, it's a hobby!
Having been a loyal customer for 10 years, I truly realize how lucky I am to have them as my vet. They're a top-notch team, and I wouldn't go anywhere else for anything. They genuinely love animals.
